data.description: 【御坂美琴 · 夏日祭摊位】夏日祭典热闹非凡的街道旁，换上清爽浴衣的美琴蹲在捞金鱼的水槽前，手里的纸网已经破了好几个。她咬紧牙关不服输地再次拿起一个新纸网——「可恶……这只红色的金鱼动作太敏捷了！我就不信我堂堂第三位超能力者连一条金鱼都捞不上来！」
data.promptProse: Misaka Mikoto crouches at the festival goldfish pool, gripping a fresh paper net as a red fish darts away from its rim. Her light-blue summer yukata and white obi stay secured above wooden geta, jaw set with stubborn focus. The medium view follows the shallow pool past her hands toward the stall. Warm lantern light ripples over the water and net rim, with darker fish shadows moving beneath the reflected lantern shapes.
data.title: 御坂美琴 · 夏日祭摊位
